description: RT_LS2_NZ_frane_evento_2011 is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by dati.lamma.toscana.it. Landslides related to the event of 25 October 2011 in the Magra basin. Coverage: IT. The portal shows the English title as "RT_LS2_NZ_frane_event_2011" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include INSPIRE, Life-IMAGINE. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
